INSERT INTO job_runtime_configs (
            job_type,
            schema_version,
            config,
            updated_by_user_id
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
         ON CONFLICT (job_type)
         DO UPDATE
            SET schema_version = EXCLUDED.schema_version,
                config = EXCLUDED.config,
                updated_by_user_id = EXCLUDED.updated_by_user_id,
                updated_at = now()
